footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 31.0% to $881M in 2025. Gross margin was 57.4%, versus 57.6% a year earlier, and operating income rose 35.2% to $253M, a 28.8% margin.
Net income rose 41.1% to $259M, or $7.96 per share. Operating cash flow was $246M and free cash flow $218M, versus $218M; Nova returned $35.0M through buybacks.
sources: Nova Ltd. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
